title: Post-apocalyptic game — Demo 2.0 update
author: No_Piano_1857
selftext:
A few days ago I pushed an update to a small post-apocalyptic project I’ve been working on.
The update focused mainly on atmosphere and usability — refreshed visuals, smoother movement, and clearer feedback during turn-based combat.
I’m especially curious how the overall vibe comes across:
does it feel lonely, tense, and fitting for a ruined world, or does anything feel off?

comments.author: No_Piano_1857
comments.body:
For anyone who wants more context, here’s the current demo:
https://marcin4001.itch.io/arkansas-2125
Feedback on atmosphere and presentation is always welcome.

comments.author: sharkymcstevenson2
comments.body: I like the visual style a lot, good job. You’re using unity as the engine, so where does AI come in exactly?

replies.author: No_Piano_1857
replies.body: Yes, it's a Unity engine. AI was used in posters, for writing dialogue, item descriptions, and the backgrounds of menus and the prologue.

comments.author: CosmikStudios
comments.body: It resembles Fallout which is awesome. I'd focus on the ground textures next so it doesn't feel so "naked".
